synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.
synthesis.building_stock: Established inner south-eastern suburb with significant heritage building stock (Victoria Heritage Register listings include Stonington mansion (1890), Malvern tram depot, former ES&A Bank, Malvern railway station) and several Victorian-era parks and gardens; Glenferrie Road and High Street are the main shopping/retail strips. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malvern,_Victoria]
synthesis.council_notes: LGA: City of Stonnington | postcode 3144 | 8 km south-east of the Melbourne CBD
content_angles_for_commercial_page: Office & corporate cleaning (after-hours servicing, common areas & washrooms)
